pages.text: Each dimension in $(thing)IridescentCraft$() has unique mechanical modifiers beyond simple mob difficulty scaling. Entering a new dimension unprepared is the most reliable way to die here.$(br2)These mechanics are applied by a KubeJS server script and stack with the standard mob scaling configs.

pages.title: Overworld, Twilight, Aether
pages.text: $(bold)Overworld$() — Baseline. $(thing)Champions$() spawn at standard rate.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest$() — Persistent Darkness debuff underground. Boss-guarded progression — you cannot reach later zones without defeating previous zone bosses.$(br2)$(bold)The Aether$() — Falling damage doubled. No natural regen while airborne. Vertical combat is the primary challenge.

pages.title: Tier 3 Dimensions
pages.text: $(bold)Undergarden$() — Constant Poison I. All mobs inflict Wither on hit (1s duration). Healing items 25% less effective.$(br2)$(bold)Deeper & Darker$() — Noise detection mechanic (KubeJS). Mob aggro radius scales with your armor sound. Sprint-walking in full iron is very loud.$(br2)$(bold)Nether$() — All mobs start aggro'd. No ambient neutral mobs. Lava damage increased 50%.

pages.title: Tier 4 Dimensions
pages.text: $(bold)Deep Aether$() — Celestial Events every 20 min: all mobs receive +50% damage and speed for 3 minutes. Watch the sky — it changes color before an event.$(br2)$(bold)The End$() — Three escalating zones. Outer Islands: manageable. Deep End: elite mobs, Void environmental damage. Dragon's Domain: the endgame. Ender Dragon scales progressively with each kill.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies$() — Elemental damage ignores standard armor. Magic resistance (Sorcery tree) is unusually valuable here.
